MSc Finance | University of Eastvale
University of Eastvale
MSc Finance
Postgraduate taught, 2027 entry
Overview
The MSc Finance is a one-year full-time programme taught in English at the Eastvale Business School.
Duration: 12 months full-time
Start date: September 2027
Fees and funding
Tuition fees (2027/28)
Home students: £16,900 per year
International students: £38,500 per year
Entry requirements
Academic requirements
We normally require a 2:1 honours degree or equivalent in a quantitative subject.
Applicants from China: Bachelor's degree from a 985 or 211 university with an overall average of at least 80%; applicants from other recognised universities need an overall average of at least 85%.
Applicants must have completed modules in calculus and statistics.
Applicants are expected to have at least 2 years of relevant work experience.
English language requirements
IELTS 7.0 overall with no less than 6.5 in each component.
TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 22 in each section.
GMAT/GRE
GMAT or GRE scores are not required.
How to apply
Application deadlines
Round 1: 15 November 2026
Round 2: 15 January 2027
Round 3: 1 March 2027
We recommend that you apply early as places are limited.
